physicians.title: For Physicians
physicians.subtitle: Relieving the burden on physicians through structured, continuous, and long-term therapy monitoring.
physicians.benefits_text: Complete, physician- and practice-oriented progress data instead of unstructured patient notes. Track symptom progression, pain scales, and tolerability in real time.
physicians.compliance_text: Fully GDPR compliant, AES-256 encrypted, and certified as a Class I Medical Device.
physicians.hero_title: The Monthly Review That Writes Itself
physicians.hero_intro: Medical cannabis therapy requires continuous, structured documentation — not quarterly guesswork. Cannathera automatically aggregates each patient's daily symptom logs, pain scales, tolerability ratings, and strain-specific responses into a comprehensive monthly review. When your patient arrives for their follow-up consultation, the clinical picture is already complete, structured, and ready for your assessment. No more scrambling through unstructured notes. No more blind spots between appointments.
physicians.f1_text: At the end of each month, Cannathera compiles a structured, physician-facing therapy summary for every patient. It includes day-by-day symptom progression, validated NRS pain scale scores, sleep quality trends, and tolerability flags — all automatically generated from the patient's daily Active Accompaniment entries. You receive a clinical document, not a raw data dump.
physicians.f2_text: You don't need to wait for the monthly review to detect problems. Our validated triage logic continuously monitors each patient's daily entries against their baseline parameters. When a clinically significant deviation occurs — a sudden pain spike, an unreported side effect, a missed titration step — you receive an immediate, prioritized alert, enabling rapid, targeted intervention before the situation escalates.
physicians.f3_text: Issue E-Prescriptions that route automatically to a patient's preferred local pharmacy within a 30km radius. Every prescription is time-stamped, cryptographically signed, and archived in a fully GDPR-compliant, AES-256 encrypted environment. Status updates — Received, Preparing, Ready, Dispensed — flow back to your practice in real time, eliminating follow-up calls and administrative back-and-forth.
physicians.f4_title: Structured Outcome Data for Evidence-Based Adjustments
physicians.f4_text: Every dosage change, strain substitution, or titration step is documented against measurable outcome metrics. Over time, this builds a rich, longitudinal dataset for each patient — enabling evidence-based treatment decisions grounded in actual, structured clinical data rather than anecdotal patient recall. This is the foundation of responsible, defensible cannabis therapy management.

pharmacies.title: For Pharmacies
pharmacies.subtitle: Become the anchor of a verified, closed-loop local cannabis therapy network.
pharmacies.hero_title: Your Pharmacy at the Centre of a Closed-Loop Local Network
pharmacies.hero_intro: Cannathera doesn't just list your pharmacy — it makes you an active, indispensable node in a verified, closed local therapy ecosystem. Patients are not scraped from the internet and anonymously redirected. Instead, they select your pharmacy as their permanent, trusted partner. Prescriptions from local physicians route exclusively to you. Therapy outcomes flow back to the prescribing practice. You are not a passive point of sale — you are the dispensing anchor of a medically structured, fully accountable local care loop.
pharmacies.f1_text: Our proprietary 30km hyper-local routing guarantees that patients within your catchment area are directed to your pharmacy — not to a national mail-order competitor. Patients actively choose you as their 'Favorite Pharmacy', and once selected, all their future prescriptions route exclusively to you. This creates genuine patient loyalty, not algorithmic randomness. You build a reliable, growing base of returning patients, each with a documented therapy history you can access and act on.
pharmacies.f2_text: Manage your entire medical cannabis workflow from a single, purpose-built screen. Incoming E-Prescriptions arrive with complete physician documentation, patient therapy context, and strain specifications. You update fulfillment statuses in real time — Received, Preparing, Ready, Dispensed — and the patient and prescribing physician are notified automatically at each step. Secure in-platform messaging allows for direct, GDPR-compliant communication with both patients and practices, eliminating fragmented phone calls and fax-based chaos.
pharmacies.f3_text: Unlike directory aggregators that scrape your address from the internet and list you without consent, Cannathera operates exclusively on verified, opt-in partnerships. Every pharmacy on our platform has been onboarded individually. This means you control your profile, your capacity, and your patient relationships. There are no anonymous leads, no commoditised comparisons, and no race to the bottom on price. You compete on quality, locality, and trust — the factors that actually matter in cannabis care.
pharmacies.f4_title: Closing the Loop: Outcome Data Back to Prescribers
pharmacies.f4_text: When you dispense a prescription, the chain doesn't end there. Patient therapy outcomes — pain scores, tolerability ratings, side-effect flags — are continuously collected and automatically structured into monthly reports that flow back to the prescribing physician. You are not just a dispenser; you are a clinically integrated partner. Physicians see which strains you dispensed, patients record their responses, and the entire care triangle operates with shared, real-time clinical data.
pharmacies.val_text: Transparency in strain selection, support for patients in determining the correct dosage, and documentation of side effects as part of ongoing support.
pharmacies.comm_text: How the platform supports communication and a streamlined process between the patient, prescribing practice, and dispensing pharmacy.
pharmacies.qual_text: Information on professional qualifications (practical background and certified consultation) and how pharmacies can be involved as partners or points of contact.

telemedicine.title: For Telemedicine Providers
telemedicine.subtitle: Integration of digital, ongoing therapy support into fully digital treatment processes and remote consultations.
telemedicine.v2_hero_title: Scale Telemedicine Without Scaling Physician Workload
telemedicine.v2_hero_intro: The core bottleneck of telemedicine is physician capacity. Every unstructured patient message, every administrative follow-up, every undocumented interim complaint consumes clinical time that should be spent on actual medical decisions. Cannathera eliminates that bottleneck. Our platform pre-filters, structures, and clinically stratifies all patient-generated therapy data before it ever reaches a physician — so your medical team operates at maximum clinical throughput with minimum administrative drag. The result: you can serve significantly more patients per physician, per month, without compromising safety or outcomes.
telemedicine.v2_f1_text: Cannathera's RESTful API connects directly into your existing clinical software stack — whether you run a proprietary EMR, a third-party telemedicine platform, or a custom patient app. Prescription routing, triage data, therapy outcomes, and patient sync all operate via secure, versioned API endpoints with full webhook support. For enterprise clients, we offer white-label deployment: your branding, your patient-facing interface, our clinical infrastructure underneath. SLA-backed uptime guarantees and a dedicated integration engineering contact are included.
telemedicine.v2_f2_title: Long-Term Patient Retention, Not One-Off Consultations
telemedicine.v2_f2_text: The economics of telemedicine depend on lifetime patient value, not single-session volume. Cannathera transforms one-time prescription patients into long-term, daily-active platform users. Our Active Accompaniment feature prompts patients to log their therapy data every day — pain levels, sleep, mood, side effects — creating a continuous digital engagement loop anchored to your platform. Patients don't just come back for renewals; they stay because their health is actively managed. This dramatically increases retention rates, reduces churn, and creates a recurring revenue base that grows with therapy duration.
telemedicine.v2_f3_title: Clinical Pre-Filtering: Physicians See Only What Matters
telemedicine.v2_f3_text: Without Cannathera, your physicians are buried in unstructured patient messages, ad-hoc emails, and unvalidated self-reports. With Cannathera, all incoming patient data is standardised against validated clinical instruments — NRS pain scales, PSQI sleep indices, tolerability matrices — before it reaches a physician's inbox. Triage logic automatically stratifies cases by clinical urgency: routine stable cases, watchlist cases requiring scheduled review, and immediate alerts requiring same-day physician action. Your physicians invest their time exactly where clinical value is highest, and nowhere else.
telemedicine.v2_feat1_text: Cannathera integrates into your existing telemedicine infrastructure via REST API and webhooks with no patient-facing disruption. Prescription flows, therapy tracking, and triage data connect seamlessly to your current EMR or patient portal without requiring patients to switch platforms or learn new interfaces.
telemedicine.v2_feat2_text: Eliminate manual follow-up scheduling. Cannathera automatically triggers structured patient check-ins at clinically appropriate intervals — weekly during titration, monthly during stable maintenance — and escalates to physician review only when the data warrants it. Your team is notified precisely when intervention is needed, not before and not after.
telemedicine.v2_feat3_title: GDPR-compliant triage & remote monitoring at enterprise scale
telemedicine.v2_feat3_text: All therapy data is collected, processed, and stored in a fully GDPR-compliant architecture with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. As a certified Class I Medical Device, Cannathera meets the regulatory requirements for clinical data processing in the EU. Audit logs, data export, and data portability are fully supported for regulatory reporting and enterprise compliance teams.
telemedicine.v2_feat4_title: White-label scalability with your brand identity
telemedicine.v2_feat4_text: Deploy Cannathera's entire clinical infrastructure under your own brand. Patient-facing interfaces, email communications, report headers, and app store listings can all carry your identity. As your patient volume grows from hundreds to tens of thousands, the infrastructure scales with you — without renegotiating contracts or re-engineering integrations. Enterprise volume pricing ensures your cost per patient decreases as your scale increases.
